2610.06241.title: Few-Shot Prototype Head Adaptation for On-Device ECG Personalization on PSoC~6
2610.06241.paper_summary: Wearable and bedside electrocardiogram (ECG) monitors must adapt to patient-specific morphology to maintain arrhythmia detection accuracy across users, yet personalization is typically performed offline and cannot account for individual physiology, electrode placement, or recording drift. On-device adaptation by backpropagation is expensive for microcontroller-class medical devices because it requires an optimizer state, repeated backward passes through convolutional layers, and labeled arrhythmic beats that may not be available at deployment time. This letter proposes prototype-only head adaptation as a compact personalization primitive for TinyML ECG systems. A one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1-D CNN; 1,314 parameters and 72.6k multiply-accumulate operations per beat) is trained offline on the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database under an inter-patient protocol, frozen as a feature extractor, and exported to a PSoC 6 microcontroller. Patient-specific adaptation then reduces to computing closed-form class means in a 32-dimensional embedding space, requiring no convolutional backward pass, no iterative optimization, and only one forward pass per support beat. Prototype adaptation improves inter-patient macro-F1 from 0.635/0.639/0.646 to 0.731/0.771/0.797 at 1/5/10-shot, outperforming linear stochastic-gradient-descent (SGD) head fine-tuning at every shot count for the target tiny backbone. On-device replay over 18 one-shot episodes on a PSoC 6 Cortex-M4F matches the host macro-F1 for the prototype head (0.798), with 11.39 ms per beat, 5.2 KB flash, and 22.2 KB SRAM. A restricted variant that updates only the normal-class prototype from passively buffered sinus beats yields a consistent +0.05 macro-F1 gain, reducing the annotation burden during initial
2610.06241.paper_summary_zh: 可穿戴和床邊心電圖（ECG）監測器必須適應病人特定的形態，以保持跨用戶的心律不整檢測準確性，然而個性化通常是在離線進行，無法考慮個體生理、電極放置或錄音漂移。對於微控制器級別的醫療設備，通過反向傳播進行設備內適應是昂貴的，因為這需要優化器狀態、在卷積層中重複進行反向傳播，以及在部署時可能無法獲得的標記心律不整的節拍。本文提出原型專用頭適應作為TinyML ECG系統的一種緊湊個性化原語。一維卷積神經網絡（1-D CNN；每個節拍1,314個參數和72.6k次乘加運算）在MIT-BIH心律不整數據庫上根據跨病人協議進行離線訓練，凍結為特徵提取器，並導出到PSoC 6微控制器。病人特定的適應則簡化為在32維嵌入空間中計算閉式類別均值，無需卷積反向傳播、無需迭代優化，且每個支持節拍僅需一次前向傳播。原型適應在1/5/10次拍攝時將跨病人宏觀F1從0.635/0.639/0.646提高到0.731/0.771/0.797，超越了每次拍攝計數下針對目標小型骨幹的線性隨機梯度下降（SGD）頭微調。在PSoC 6 Cortex-M4F上進行的18次一次性回放與原型頭的主機宏觀F1（0.798）相匹配，每個節拍11.39毫秒，5.2 KB閃存和22.2 KB SRAM。一個限制變體僅從被動緩衝的正弦節拍中更新正常類別原型，產生一致的+0.05宏觀F1增益，減少了初始標註負擔。
